text:
alex: P1 from enterprise customer — autoroute executed create_credit_note instead of refund_payment. Customer expected a bank refund, but got a credit note emailed. Case CS-4239 opened. Need quick repro and mitigation.

alex: Request payload we received (sanitized):
```json
{"order_id": "ord_9XJ", "amount": "120.00", "currency": "USD", "reason": "product defective", "method": "bank_transfer"}
```

jamie: Logs show router chosen tool create_credit_note (score 0.78) vs refund_payment (0.21). Looks like heuristic favored credit note. :thinking_face:

rana: Can you paste trace id? I'll pull the router decision payload and model inputs.

alex: trace=tr_7c8d9e — attached router decision (score breakdown) in case notes. Quick excerpt: create_credit_note matched on fields [order_id, amount, reason], refund_payment matched on [order_id, amount] but lower weight on reason.

pat: Do we have a schema mismatch? IIRC refund_payment expects amount:number while credit_note accepts amount:string or text. If so, fuzzy matcher might prefer credit_note when amount is a string.

alex: Repro steps (customer flow):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auto-route -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"order_id":"ord_9XJ","amount":"120.00","currency":"USD","reason":"product defective","method":"bank_transfer"}'
2) Observe response 200 and router action create_credit_note invoked
3) Customer receives store credit instead of funds refunded to bank account

jamie: Short-term mitigation: add a routing rule bump for refund_payment when method == "bank_transfer" OR currency present and amount matches money format. Patch priority: high.

rana: Hypothesis: fuzzy model treats numeric strings as natural language and weights 'reason' heavily, pushing to credit_note. I'll run a local matcher test matrix (string vs number amount, with/without reason). Will post minimal repro script.

pat: Also add telemetry: log chosen_tool vs invoked_tool + payload schema types for 24h window so we can find similar incidents.

alex: Customer is on escalations queue. They want ETA and confirmation when fix is deployed.

rana: Running matching experiments now. Early result: when amount sent as number (120.00) refund_payment score > credit_note. When amount is string ("120.00") credit_note often wins if reason present.

pat: Ok — quick rule implemented: prefer refund_payment when payload includes method==bank_transfer OR amount is numeric string matching ^\d+\.\d{2}$ and currency present. Will roll a canary in prod for support org only.

alex: Please notify CS once canary live. :pray:

router-bot: auto-router flagged heuristic_mismatch for trace tr_7c8d9e and created incident inc_2023-09-14-001

rana: I'll follow up with a PR that strengthens type signals in function signatures (explicit money type) and add unit tests for fuzzy matcher. ETA for PR: ~2h.

jamie: Thanks team. Pat — please coordinate the canary and rollback plan. alex — I'll update the customer with interim workaround: resend with numeric amount field to force refund_payment.

alex: Copy. Updating case notes now.

pat: Assigned to eng-platform runbook: set temporary routing rule + alert if chosen_tool != invoked_tool > 0.5% for any billing-related workflows.

alex: Closing loop for now, will post customer acknowledgement when they confirm refund processed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
